## OutgoingMessageInfo Class

Contains the plaintext content and send status of a retained outgoing direct message from one local snapshot\.

```csharp
public sealed class OutgoingMessageInfo
```

Inheritance [System\.Object](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.object 'System\.Object') → OutgoingMessageInfo

### Remarks
Outbox entries have no local history sequence\. Match [Status](Meshline.Models.Client.OutgoingMessageInfo.md#Meshline.Models.Client.OutgoingMessageInfo.Status 'Meshline\.Models\.Client\.OutgoingMessageInfo\.Status')'s message identifier with the current account's history to avoid displaying a synchronized send twice\.
